The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is the zebra.

Regarding the security issues in the provided text, the e-commerce platform faces significant cloud computing security risks primarily due to misconfigured network access controls. The core vulnerability lies in the lack of proper restrictions on public cloud storage buckets, which allowed unauthorized entities to access sensitive data. This represents a critical failure in identity and access management (IAM) and data protection, leading directly to data leaks. To mitigate such risks, the platform must implement strict access policies, such as private bucket settings, role-based access control (RBAC), and regular security audits to ensure that data storage remains secure and accessible only to authorized users.
